title: Guided setup, support tickets, and reliable updates
notes: New: Fresh installs begin with a four-part guide covering account protection, planner setup, daily planning, scanning, and support.
New: Send organized support tickets from inside the app without opening an email app; app and device details are added automatically.
Required follow-up: A valid reply email is required for every ticket, with the signed-in Google address filled in automatically.
Privacy: Planner records and photos are never attached to support tickets, and submission requires clear consent.
Improved: Update downloads show live progress, allow slow transfers, retry interrupted connections up to three times, and explain failures clearly.
